_readme: S721 lever, Saddleback College's second read (the first, 45382520936, searched the Credit Programs A-Z navigation in mixed case, and the navigation prints its titles in capitals). The only catalog the host lists is 'Saddleback 2026-2027 Spring' (id 4420), and its Credit Programs A-Z section's entries are the navigation call under parentId 48776 (208,699 bytes). This read loads that call and prints every entry naming retailing, school-age care, a master teacher, a site supervisor or a business information worker, so a session sees whether each of the lever's 7 programs (04054, 22844, 22895, 22896, 22897, 36224, 36225) has an entry of its own. No model call, nothing written.

questions.own_page: Which A-Z entry, if any, is each program's own in the 2026-2027 catalog (its id, text and urlalias).
